## Landed · 2026-11-15T23:22Z

PR #34123 merged as `196af0a3` (ACCEPT 6901087740; contract review PASS 6900687101). `--modes ask` installs a verified build (`--template F`, else this run's passing scratch build) into a blank host by the same unmanaged install template mode uses, seeds it, and runs the Run half alone: every question (`--ask-repeats` honoured) and every operation. No authoring turn runs, nothing is scored, and there is no iterate. Its turns key as `card/ask/run/…` and `recorded:` replays them; on one build and one set of turns its grades equal scratch mode's first Run half. `ask` with neither `--template` nor `scratch` is refused before any card runs. The scorecard's `ask` column reads `supplied` in its Build cells and `no authoring turns` in its author rows, with the build's source named; the gallery exporter reads such a record and passes over the ask mode with the reason stated. Default modes are unchanged byte for byte. `pm:dispatched` dropped; card thread closing. Queue ① moves to #33743.
